mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT category FROM tools WHERE category != '' ORDER BY category ASC
SELECT id, name, url, icon, note, category, sort_order, created_at, updated_at FROM tools ORDER BY category ASC, sort_order ASC, created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tools (id, name, url, icon, note, category, sort_order, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{url}, #{icon}, #{note}, #{category}, #{sortOrder}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE tools SET sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE id = #{id}
